newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: GOLF-IN-FORM ELS AIMS FOR MILLION DOLLAR SUCCESS.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-IN-FORM ELS AIMS FOR MILLION DOLLAR SUCCESS.

text.p: British Open champion Tom Lehman and three times world matchplay winner Ernie Els head a formidable field of 12 for the 1996 Million Dollar Challenge starting on Thursday.
Lehman is probably the form player of the year while Els comes to the Gary Player Country Club fresh from South Africa's commanding World Cup victory last weekend.
Els, who has never won the Sun City event said: "I've thought about this tournament every day for a whole year. It's one I really want to win -- and need to win."
Lehman, among six Americans in the entry, is expected to do well on the long layout which places a heavy premum on accuracy with its punishing rough.
The three other 1996 major winners will be present -- Masters champion Nick Faldo, U.S. Open victor Steve Jones and PGA winner Mark Brooks. Jones and Brooks make their debuts.
1994 winner Faldo apart, four other previous Million Dollar champions will be in action -- holder Corey Pavin, Nick Price, Bernhard Langer and Ian Woosnam.
Europe number one Colin Montgomerie, and Americans Mark O'Meara and Steve Stricker complete the line-up.
